dual-thumb-mode:
Dual-Thumb Mode

ThumbDualValueModeEnabled turns the slider into a range picker. Each thumb binds its own state path and aria label. ThumbUpper takes its own colors, labels, icons, and bubble styling.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbDualValueModeEnabled:      true,
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath:      "lowerValue",
	ThumbUpperValueTwoWayStatePath: "upperValue",
	TrackStartValue:                "0",
	TrackEndValue:                  "100",

	// OptionalFields
	Thumb: uiControl.RangeSliderThumbSettings{
		AriaLabel:            "Minimum price",
		ValueBubbleEnabled:   true,
		ValueBubbleRingColor: "emerald-200",
	},
	ThumbUpper: uiControl.RangeSliderThumbSettings{
		AriaLabel:                  "Maximum price",
		TextColor:                  "neutral-50",
		Label:                      "Max",
		LabelIcon:                  "ph-arrow-up",
		LabelOneWayStatePath:       "upperValue",
		ValueBubbleEnabled:         true,
		ValueBubbleDisplayMode:     uiControl.RangeSliderThumbValueBubbleDisplayModeHover,
		ValueBubbleTextColor:       "neutral-50",
		ValueBubbleRingColor:       "red-700",
		ValueBubbleRingThickness:   uiToolset.RingThicknessLg,
		ValueBubbleSize:            uiControl.RangeSliderThumbValueBubbleSizeLg,
	},
})

initial-state-normalization:
Initial State Normalization

ShouldNormalizeInitialState orders crossed thumbs and pulls out-of-range values back into the track on load. Without it the thumbs start where the state says.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbDualValueModeEnabled:      true,
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath:      "lowerValue",
	ThumbUpperValueTwoWayStatePath: "upperValue",

	// OptionalFields
	ShouldNormalizeInitialState: true,
	TrackStartValue:             "0",
	TrackEndValue:               "100",
})

sizes:
Sizes

Size scales the track, thumb, and labels: xs, sm, md, lg, or xl.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",

	// OptionalFields
	Size: uiControl.RangeSliderSizeMd,
})

static-thumb-values:
Static Thumb Values

ThumbValue places one thumb without binding Alpine state. In dual mode ThumbUpperValue places the upper thumb.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbDualValueModeEnabled: true,
	ThumbValue:                "25",
	ThumbUpperValue:           "75",

	// OptionalFields
	TrackStartValue: "0",
	TrackEndValue:   "100",
})

Live Example
steps-ticks:
Steps & Ticks

TrackSteps snaps the thumb to increments. Track.TicksEnabled draws tick marks every Track.TickStep.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",

	// OptionalFields
	TrackSteps: "20",
	Track: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackSettings{
		TicksEnabled: true,
		TickStep:     "25",
	},
})

Live Example
thumb-colors-icons:
Thumb Colors & Icons

Thumb background and text colors accept Tailwind tokens. Thumb.Label prints static text on the thumb, Thumb.LabelIcon stamps an icon on it, and Thumb.LabelOneWayStatePath prints live state on it.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",

	// OptionalFields
	Thumb: uiControl.RangeSliderThumbSettings{
		BackgroundColor:      "emerald-500",
		TextColor:            "neutral-50",
		Label:                "A",
		LabelIcon:            "ph-check",
		LabelOneWayStatePath: "sliderValue",
	},
})

track-colors-icons:
Track Colors & Icons

Track background colors paint a solid or gradient track, and Track.FillColor paints the filled span. Label text colors and icons mark the bounds.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",
	TrackStartValue:           "0",
	TrackEndValue:             "100",

	// OptionalFields
	Track: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackSettings{
		BackgroundColor:          "neutral-50/15",
		BackgroundColorFrom:      "red-500",
		BackgroundColorVia:       "emerald-500",
		BackgroundColorTo:        "cyan-500",
		FillColor:                "sky-500",
		FillColorVia:             "yellow-500",
		StartValueLabelTextColor: "red-500",
		EndValueLabelTextColor:   "cyan-500",
	},
})

Live Example
track-labels:
Track Labels

Track start and end labels print the range bounds from static values or Alpine state. Their position moves the labels above or below the track, and their icons mark each bound.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath:      "sliderValue",
	TrackStartValueOneWayStatePath: "rangeStart",
	TrackEndValueOneWayStatePath:   "rangeEnd",

	// OptionalFields
	Track: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackSettings{
		StartValueLabelEnabled:  true,
		StartValueLabelPosition: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackValueLabelPositionTop,
		StartValueLabelIcon:     "ph-arrow-left",
		EndValueLabelEnabled:    true,
		EndValueLabelPosition:   uiControl.RangeSliderTrackValueLabelPositionTop,
		EndValueLabelIcon:       "ph-arrow-right",
	},
})

Live Example
track-tooltip:
Track Tooltip

Track.TooltipEnabled previews the value under the pointer as it moves along the track. The preview snaps to TrackSteps and clamps to the track bounds. Track.TooltipRingColor and Track.TooltipRingThickness outline it.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",

	// OptionalFields
	Track: uiControl.RangeSliderTrackSettings{
		TooltipEnabled:         true,
		TooltipPosition:        uiControl.RangeSliderTrackTooltipPositionTop,
		TooltipBackgroundColor: "primary-500",
		TooltipTextColor:       "neutral-50",
		TooltipRingColor:       "primary-200",
		TooltipRingThickness:   uiToolset.RingThicknessMd,
	},
})

Live Example
value-bubble:
Value Bubble

Thumb.ValueBubbleEnabled shows the live value above or below the thumb. The default display mode always shows it; ValueBubbleDisplayModeHover shows it only while the slider is hovered or dragged. Bubble colors, size, shape, ring, and position style it.

Usage 

@uiControl.RangeSlider(uiControl.RangeSliderSettings{
	ThumbValueTwoWayStatePath: "sliderValue",

	// OptionalFields
	Thumb: uiControl.RangeSliderThumbSettings{
		ValueBubbleEnabled:         true,
		ValueBubbleDisplayMode:     uiControl.RangeSliderThumbValueBubbleDisplayModeHover,
		ValueBubblePosition:        uiControl.RangeSliderThumbValueBubblePositionTop,
		ValueBubbleBackgroundColor: "red-500",
		ValueBubbleTextColor:       "neutral-50",
		ValueBubbleSize:            uiControl.RangeSliderThumbValueBubbleSizeLg,
		ValueBubbleShape:           uiToolset.ShapeRounded,
		ValueBubbleRingColor:       "violet-500",
		ValueBubbleRingThickness:   uiToolset.RingThicknessXl,
	},
})
